questions.question: What is the reflection of point (-1, -5) on the line x - 3 = 0? रेखा x - 3 = 0 पर बिंदु का प्रतिबिंब (-1, -5) क्या है?
questions.solution:
Mid-point of original point and reflected point on the line is the foot of perpendicular on the line.

The formula for finding the foot of perpendicular from point (x1, y1) on the line (ax + by + c = 0) is-

(x - x1)/a = (y - y1)/b = -(ax1 + by1 + c)/(a2 + b2)

(ax + by + c = 0) = (x - 3) and (x1, y1) = (-1, -5)

After comparing-

a = 1, b = 0, c = -3, x1 = -1 and y1 = -5

From the equation-

(x + 1)/1 = (y + 5)/0 = -(1 * (-1) + 0 * (-5) - 3)/(12 + 02)

(x + 1)/1 = (y + 5)/0 = 4

(x + 1)/1 = 4

x + 1 = 4

x = 3

(y + 5)/0 = 4

y + 5 = 0

y = -5

Co-ordinates of foot of perpendicular = (x, y) = (3, -5)

Let co-ordinates of reflected point = (p, q)

(p - 1)/2, (q - 5)/2 = (3, -5)

(p - 1)/2 = 3

p = 7

(q - 5)/2 = -5

q = -5

Hence, co-ordinates of reflected point = (p, q) = (7, -5)

questions.question: What is the unit digit of 65 th power of (2061 - 1986 + 678 - 259)? (2061 - 1986 + 678 - 259) के 65वें घात के इकाई का अंक क्या है?
questions.solution:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

= (2061 - 1986 + 678 - 259)

= 494

In 49465:

Unit digit of 494 is 4.

From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 4 is 2.

So, we have to divide the power of 494 i.e.65 by 2.

After dividing 65 by 2, remainder = 1. So, power ≠ cyclicity

Let the project involve 60 units of work. (Since, 60 is the LCM of 20 and 30)

Hence, A can do 60/20 = 3 units of work per day and B can do 60/30 = 2 units of work per day.

After A quits, B is working alone on the project for the last 10 days.

∴ Work done by B in last 10 days = 2(10) = 20 units.

∴ Work done by A and B together = 60 − 20 = 40 units

A and B can together do 3 + 2 = 5 units per day

∴ Time for which A and B worked together = 40/5 = 8 days

∴ Total time in which project is actually completed = 8 + 10 = 18 days

Hence, option c is correct.

It is given that Ram, Sham and Mohan start a business with investments in the ratio 1:2:3

Initial contribution of Ram Rs "a"

Initial contribution of Sham is Rs 2a

And initial contribution of Mohan is 3a

It is given that Mohan and Sham leave the business after 4 and 8 months respectively.

Total contribution of Ram, Mohan and Sham over twelve month period is:

Contribution of Ram = (Initial investment x Period of investment) = a x 12 = 12a

Contribution of Sham = 2a x 8 = 16a

Contribution of Mohan = 3a x 4 = 12 a

Share of Ram in total profit = Contribution of Ram/ Total contribution = 12a/(12a + 16a + 12a)

= 12/40 = 3/10

But it is given that total profit = Rs 600000

Therefore, Ram's profit = (3/10) x (600000) = Rs 180000
